title: native_parse test broken at HEAD: SERIAL=n on native_sim kills UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN -> LICHEN_NATIVE silently off
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-at2y validation. lichen/tests/native_parse fails at HEAD on both worker8 (configure proceeds with warnings, compile dies: lichen/native.h not found) and pristine main checkout 8d7776e2fc (configure aborts on Kconfig warnings). Root cause chain: prj.conf sets CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN=y but SERIAL is not enabled, so the symbol falls back to n; LICHEN_NATIVE depends on UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN and silently turns off, so lichen/lib/native include dirs never reach the app. Fix: add CONFIG_SERIAL=y (and CONFIG_CONSOLE=y as needed) to tests/native_parse/prj.conf. Note: configure-abort vs proceed differs by recipe (west workspace vs cmake -DZEPHYR_MODULES); the symbol-level breakage is recipe-independent.
close_reason: Root cause differed from bead description: CONFIG_SERIAL=y was already present; the real break is that native_sim's ptty UART driver never selects SERIAL_SUPPORT_INTERRUPT, so UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN (and hence LICHEN_NATIVE, which depends on it) is unsatisfiable on native_sim. Promptless CONFIG_SERIAL_SUPPORT_INTERRUPT=y assignment is rejected by Zephyr Kconfig. Fix (test-only): prj.conf drops the silently-falling CONFIG_LICHEN_NATIVE=y; CMakeLists compiles lib/native/native.c directly into the app with the TEST_PARSE/TEST_TX defines and buffer-sizing symbols. Suite never opens a UART (TX captured, init not called). Verified on heft native_sim/native/64: 15/15 pass. 3x codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases found F1/F2 (macro redefinition + duplicate native.c if LICHEN_NATIVE ever turns on) and F3 (contradictory prj.conf) — fixed, re-verified by rebuild+run; final re-review pass timed out and was self-verified per protocol.
